podcast.body: This EP was released for free by Lorde, a teenage indie musician, in recognition that her young fanbase often lacked credit cards for streaming music services. "She released an EP called The Love Club for free because she knew that fans, most of them, as young as her, didn't have access to her credit card so they couldn't get streaming music services."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The History of the 2010s Part 2: The Role of Indie Rock

podcast.body: This EP, which began its life on SoundCloud, preceded Lorde's debut album and featured the massively successful song "Royals." "But those who were paying attention before this had already been on board with an EP entitled The Love Club, which began life on SoundCloud."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Driven By Her: Women of the 21st Century
